name: The Lost and the Damned
source: Mord Hive v0.5, pp.063-072 (The Lost and the Damned). Statlines from datasheets pp.064-066; equipment lists p.064; Marks of the Dark Gods pp.067-068; Backgrounds ('Many Walks of Life') p.068; special skills p.066. The Warp-Touched and Spawn of Chaos have VARIABLE characteristics (rolled in play) - representative fixed values are stored with a note. The Unsanctioned Psyker's ritual list depends on its Mark of Chaos: Great Corrupter uses Nurgle Rituals (see spells.json); Chaos Undivided / Architect of Fate / Dark Prince ritual lists are pp.069-072 and not yet transcribed (TODO). heroSlots.notes: Exactly one per warband. Demagogue: this model's Leader ability reaches 12" instead of 6". Subject to the Eye of the Gods / Marks of Chaos rules (see specialRules). TODO: verify skill-table access.

specialRules.note: Demagogue: so loud are his exhortations that the Leader range is 12" instead of the usual 6".

heroSlots.notes: Psyker; gets a Mark of Chaos when hired, which determines the ritual list he uses (see Marks of the Dark Gods in specialRules). Unsanctioned: on rolling double 1s or double 6s on a Psychic Power check, roll a further D6 - on a 1 a Daemon manifests (the Psyker dies; place a Lesser Daemon using the Pox Cult Plague Bearer rules, controlled by the player on a passed Ld test vs the Demagogue, else hostile). specialRules.name: Psyker
specialRules.description: A Psyker whose Mark of Chaos determines which ritual list he uses.

heroSlots.notes: VARIABLE PROFILE: the book's WS, S, T and A are variable (WS D6, S D6, T D6, A D3), determined once every turn whenever needed - the stored line uses representative fixed values. Inconsistency (variable stats), causes Fear, uses no equipment until its variable attributes are set via Experience (roll the die instead of a normal increase and may set the attribute; may exceed human maximums). Fate: at 90 XP with attributes still variable, turns into a Spawn of Chaos. TODO: verify skill-table access.

Undivided only (available via an Unsanctioned Psyker's Mark of Chaos Undivided). Count toward the max of 15. Bought in groups of 1-5.
Animals; never gain experience. Fight without penalty for having no weapons. A Chaos World background warband may include any number. Bought in groups of 1-5.

specialRules.name: Animals
specialRules.description: Hunting Canids are animals and never gain experience.

henchmenTypes.notes: VARIABLE PROFILE: Movement is 2D6" (moved straight ahead each Movement phase; contact counts as charging) and Attacks are D6+1 (rolled at the start of each Close Combat phase) - the stored line uses representative fixed values. Fear, No Brain (never gains experience), automatically passes any Leadership test, counts as a Large Target. Fights with claws/tentacles; no weapons or armour. Only one Spawn per warband. Bought in groups of 1-5.

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.description: Spawn are revolting blasphemies and cause fear.

specialRules: The Lost and the Damned. Eye of the Gods: roll 2D6 after every battle (not if the leader didn't fight). Spawn of Chaos - if you lost, add +1 per Hero taken out of action; on 12+ the leader becomes a Chaos Spawn (XP/skills/injuries/equipment lost; if a Spawn already exists the leader is simply erased). Mark of Chaos - if you won, add +1 per enemy the leader took out of action; on 12+ choose a Mark of Chaos (thereafter the test is no longer taken until a new leader must prove himself). | Marks of the Dark Gods (never two different Marks in one warband, except Undivided; Unsanctioned Psykers choose their Mark on hire): UNDIVIDED (Leader: warband within Leader radius re-rolls failed Ld tests; Psyker may take 0-3 Beastmen counting toward the 15, re-roll 'The Lads Got Talent', uses Chaos Undivided rituals), BLOODIED HOUND (Leader: subject to frenzy, psychic powers targeting him fail on 4+; Psyker becomes a Blood Father war-priest - can't manifest powers, gains permanent +1 WS/S/T/I on a passed Ld test after taking an enemy out of hand-to-hand, loses one if he takes none; may take Strength and Combat skills), ARCHITECT OF FATE (Leader: becomes a Psyker with one random Architect of Fate ritual at -1 Difficulty unless already a psyker, plus a random mutation; Psyker options: Unbridled Knowledge - pick two powers instead of one random; Control is Power - re-roll psychic tests, second stands), GREAT CORRUPTER (Leader: +1 Toughness that may exceed racial max, re-roll on the Serious Injury table once per battle, immune to poison; Psyker uses the Nurgle Rituals and is immune to poison), DARK PRINCE (Leader: non-psychology-immune enemies can't attack him in close combat unless they pass a 3D6 Ld test dropping the lowest, else they are hit automatically; Psyker uses Dark Prince rituals and may brew Vintage Amasec instead of searching for rare items). | Backgrounds ('Many Walks of Life', chosen at creation): IMPERIAL GUARD TRAITORS (-1 to find rare items; Heroes may buy Auto/Las Guns, Bolt Pistols and Long-Las as if on their list, Henchmen get Auto/Las Guns and Carbines; Heroes have the Shooting skill tree instead of Combat), UP HIVE CULT (+1 to all rarity rolls; roll a D3 for Illegal Arms: 1 Ranger Long Rifle for 30 tn, 2 Splinter Rifle for 35 tn, 3 Eldar Mesh Weave for 40 tn added to the list; counts as +2 models for diamantine income), CHAOS WORLD (may include any number of Hunting Canids; the Demagogue starts with the Tattooed Body skill). | Hired Guns: only Chrono-Gladiators and Ogryn Bodyguards; Unsanctioned Psykers may be hired except by warbands with the Mark of the Bloodied Hound. | Mutations and the Chaos Undivided / Architect of Fate / Dark Prince ritual lists are on pp.069-072 (TODO: transcribe). Min warband size 3, max 15.
